title: MS Dhoni's 10-Year-Old FIFA Post Appears to Have Predicted the Spain vs Argentina World Cup Final
excerpt: MS Dhoni's 10-year-old post predicted the Spain vs Argentina World Cup final.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • MS Dhoni's 10-year-old post predicted the Spain vs Argentina World Cup final.
  • Dhoni's gaming session with teammates sparked viral reactions on social media.
  • Argentina defeated England 2-1, while Spain beat France 2-0 in the semifinals.
  • The final will take place at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey.
  • Dhoni remains a beloved figure, connecting cricket and football fans globally.
Dhoni's Viral Prediction
›10-year-old post predicted final matchup.
›Post featured Dhoni playing FIFA with teammates.
›Fans dubbed Dhoni a 'time traveller'.
›Chennai Super Kings amplified the moment.

Captain Cool Strikes Again — This Time in Football

As the FIFA World Cup 2026 final between Spain and Argentina approaches, eagle-eyed fans have unearthed a 10-year-old Instagram post from MS Dhoni that appears to have predicted the exact matchup — sending social media into a frenzy.

The picture, originally shared by Dhoni around 2016, shows the former India cricket captain playing the FIFA video game with teammates Axar Patel, Jaydev Unadkat, and Karun Nair. The caption? "Spain vs Argentina" — the same two teams now set to contest the 2026 World Cup final.

'Elite Ball Knowledge'

Chennai Super Kings, Dhoni's IPL franchise, reshared the image with the caption "Elite ball knowledge," amplifying the viral moment. Fans flooded social media with reactions calling Dhoni a "time traveller" and celebrating his seemingly prophetic gaming session.

While it is a coincidence — Spain and Argentina are historically strong football nations — the timing has given cricket and football fans alike a reason to celebrate Dhoni's uncanny knack for being at the center of the conversation.

The Final That the World Is Watching

The World Cup final, set for Sunday at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey, will pit Lionel Messi's Argentina against Lamine Yamal's Spain. Argentina defeated England 2-1 in the semifinals, while Spain dispatched France 2-0.

Adding to the mystique, another viral prediction has surfaced — an X post from July 2021 that stated: "Argentina just beat Spain at the 2026 World Cup final, 3-2." The post has now correctly predicted both finalists, leaving fans wondering whether the scoreline will also prove accurate.

Cricket Meets Football in the Diaspora

The Dhoni moment resonates deeply with the Indian diaspora, swept up in World Cup fever alongside the ongoing England cricket tour. Cities across the United States have seen Indian restaurants and bars hosting World Cup screenings, with communities rallying around both sports.

Dhoni, who retired from international cricket in 2020 and continues to lead CSK in the IPL, remains one of the most followed figures in Indian sport. His ability to trend globally over a decade-old gaming post is testament to his enduring connection with fans worldwide.

Whether or not Sunday's final ends 3-2, Dhoni's "prediction" has already won the internet.

Sources: Times of India, Dainik Bhaskar English, The Sun
